post.description: Step one on a new device: email a login code. Admins also send their password.
Step two: the emailed code logs this device in and sets the refresh cookie.
Log this device in with Google instead of an emailed code. Admins add their password.

Who an invitation link is for, and whether accepting it needs a password (admins).
Changes nothing. A POST, so the token never appears in a URL.

Accept an invitation: it confirms the email address, and admins set their password
(at least 8 characters). The link then stops working. It doesn't log in; the user logs
in afterwards as usual.

get.description:
Admins: other admins' open password reset requests, oldest first. Never your own, which
another admin answers. Short, so not paginated.

schema.title: Response List Reset Requests Api V1 Auth Reset Requests Get

post.description:
An admin who can't log in asks the other admins for a new password. No login. The
same answer whoever asks; the other admins are emailed after the response.

Admins: email the requester a link to set a new password, to the address already on
their account, and close the request. Never your own.

Admins: close a request without sending anything, e.g. when they didn't ask. Never your
own.

A new access token for this device, from the refresh cookie (which rotates).

On 409 `refresh_conflict`, another tab refreshed at the same moment: retry once.
Log this device out: revoke its session and clear the cookie. Always succeeds.

get.description:
Your logged-in devices, most recently used first. Admins can pass `user_id` to see
anyone's.

parameters.name: user_id

schema.description: Admins only: list this user's sessions instead of yours.
schema.title: User Id

parameters.description: Admins only: list this user's sessions instead of yours.

delete.description:
Sign one of your devices out (admins: anyone's). To sign out the device you're on,
use `POST /logout`, which also clears its cookie.

get.description: The member directory: active members in alphabetical order of display name.

post.description:
Admins: register a member and email them an invitation link. Accepting it confirms
their email, and admins choose their password with it. If the email fails, the member is
still created with `invited_at` null: send it again with `POST /users/{id}/invitation`.

get.description: Your own account, with the private fields.

patch.description: Change your own display name, birthday or bio. Admins change everything else.

post.description: Email a new code to confirm your address (after an admin changed it, say).
Confirm your email address with the code sent to it.

get.description: Admins: every account with its private fields, for managing users.
The fixed list of sub-families. Short and fixed, so not paginated.

schema.title: Response List Sub Families Api V1 Users Sub Families Get

get.description: The fixed list of promotions. Short and fixed, so not paginated.

schema.title: Response List Promotions Api V1 Users Promotions Get

get.description: One active member, as every member sees them.

patch.description:
Admins: change any of a user's fields. Send only what changes. A new email
address gets a confirmation code.

get.description:
One account with its private fields: your own, or anyone's for admins (deactivated
users included).

post.description: Admins: block a user's logins and sign them out of every device straight away.
Admins: let a deactivated user log in again (on each device, from scratch).

Admins: email a new invitation link, which replaces the old one. For members who
haven't accepted theirs yet, and for any admin: their link sets a new password, so it
also resets a forgotten one.

put.description:
Admins: credit a user's blog posts to an existing Sanity author (`null` unlinks), so
someone who wrote posts in the Studio keeps one author. Each author links to one user.

Upload a profile photo (multipart field `photo`: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, at most
5 MB): your own, or anyone's for admins. The photo it replaces is deleted afterwards.

delete.description: Remove a profile photo: your own, or anyone's for admins.

post.description:
Wish a member a happy birthday: when their birthday is today or in the next 30 days,
once per birthday, and never yourself.

get.description:
Active members whose birthday is today or in the next 30 days, soonest first, and
whether you've wished them yet. A month of birthdays is short, so it's not paginated.

schema.title: Response List Upcoming Birthdays Api V1 Wishes Upcoming Birthdays Get

to see anyone's.

post.description:
Social media managers and admins: publish a post, credited to you. Every field is
required except `slug` (made from the title) and `published_at` (now).

Social media managers and admins: upload a post's image (multipart field `image`:
JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 5 MB), then send its `asset_id` with the post.

Called by Sanity when a post or author changes (e.g. in the Studio): clears the posts
cache. No login: the call is checked by its signature instead. The body is never used,
only signed, so a valid call can do nothing but clear the cache.

get.description:
Admins: the Sanity authors and the member each is linked to, for linking them
(`PUT /users/{id}/sanity-author`). Declared before `/{slug}`, so it's never read as a
post's slug.

schema.title: Response List Authors Api V1 Posts Authors Get

get.description: One published post, with its body, by its slug.

patch.description:
Social media managers and admins: change any post's fields; send only what changes.
Its author stays the original writer.

delete.description: Social media managers and admins: delete any post.

get.description: The family's documents, newest first. `category` and `featured` narrow the list.

parameters.name: featured

schema.description: true: only featured documents; false: only the others.
schema.title: Featured

parameters.description: true: only featured documents; false: only the others.

post.description:
Social media managers and admins: share a PDF (at most 10 MB), sent as
`multipart/form-data` with `file`, `title`, `category`, and optionally `description` and
`featured`.

patch.description:
Social media managers and admins: change a document's details. Send only what
changes.

delete.description: Social media managers and admins: delete a document and, afterwards, its file.

get.description:
The PDF itself, streamed from private storage: shown in the browser, or saved with
`?download=true`. It needs the `Authorization` header like every other call, so the
frontend fetches it and shows it from a blob.

schema.description: true asks the browser to save the file instead of showing it.
schema.title: Download

parameters.description: true asks the browser to save the file instead of showing it.

put.description:
Social media managers and admins: replace a document's PDF (multipart field `file`,
at most 10 MB), keeping its details. The old file is deleted afterwards.

get.description: Liveness check for UptimeRobot. Must stay cheap and never touch the database.

expires_in.title: Expires In
expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

AccessToken.title: AccessToken
AccessToken.description: Sent with every login and refresh. The refresh token is only ever in the cookie.

AuthorLink.title: AuthorLink
AuthorLink.description: `author_id`: a Sanity author's ID (from `GET /posts/authors`), or null to unlink.

AuthorRead.title: AuthorRead
AuthorRead.description: A Sanity author, and the member it's linked to (if any).

Block.title: Block
Block.description:
One paragraph, heading, quote or list item: text spans, with bold and the like as
`marks`, and links as `markDefs` that spans point to by key.

resend_after.title: Resend After
resend_after.description: Seconds before another code can be requested.

CodeSent.title: CodeSent
CodeSent.description: The same answer whether or not the account exists.

password.title: Password
password.description: Admins only, and required for them. Ignored for members.

InvitationCheck.title: InvitationCheck
InvitationCheck.description: The token from the invitation link (after `#token=`).

needs_password.title: Needs Password
needs_password.description: Admins must choose a password (at least 8 characters) to accept.

InvitationRead.title: InvitationRead
InvitationRead.description:
What the invitation page shows before it's accepted. Only the invited person has the
link, so it's their own details.

MonthDay.title: MonthDay
MonthDay.description: A birthday without its year, which only the user and admins may see.

PostCreate.title: PostCreate
PostCreate.description:
A new post: every field is required, except `slug` (made from the title) and
`published_at` (now). Upload the image first with `POST /posts/images`.

body.title: Body
body.description: Portable Text blocks, as Sanity stores them.

PostSummary.title: PostSummary
PostSummary.description: A post in the list: everything but the body.

PostUpdate.title: PostUpdate
PostUpdate.description: Send only what changes. Nothing can be cleared: every post field stays required.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
What members may change about themselves. Send only what changes; `birthday` and
`bio` can be null to clear them. Everything else is for admins (`UserUpdate`).

ResetRequestCreate.title: ResetRequestCreate
ResetRequestCreate.description: An admin who can't log in, asking the others for a new password.

ResetRequested.title: ResetRequested
ResetRequested.description: The same answer whoever asks, so it never says who is an admin.

email.title: Email
email.description: Where the link goes: the address already on the account.

ResourceCategory.title: ResourceCategory
ResourceCategory.description:
The fixed list of categories, from the frontend's Resources page. Changed by a PR (and
a migration for the check constraint), never by users.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name it downloads under; always ends in .pdf.

ResourceRead.title: ResourceRead
ResourceRead.description:
A document's details. The file itself comes from `GET /resources/{id}/file`; its
storage ID never leaves the server.

ResourceUpdate.title: ResourceUpdate
ResourceUpdate.description:
Send only what changes. `description` can be null (or blank) to clear it; the other
fields can't be null. The file is replaced with `PUT /resources/{id}/file`.

ResourceUpload.title: ResourceUpload
ResourceUpload.description:
A new document, sent as `multipart/form-data`: the PDF in `file`, and the rest as
form fields.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Roles are cumulative: each one can do everything the roles before it can.

Check them with `role.at_least(...)` (or the `require_role` dependency), never with `<`
or `>`: a `StrEnum` compares alphabetically, not by rank.

current.title: Current
current.description: True for the device making this request.

SessionRead.title: SessionRead
SessionRead.description: One logged-in device, as its owner (or an admin) sees it. Never includes token hashes.

falls_on.title: Falls On
falls_on.description: The birthday's next date (its year, not the birth year).

wished.title: Wished
wished.description: Whether you've already wished them for this birthday.

UserCreate.title: UserCreate
UserCreate.description:
Admins only: there's no self-signup. The new user is emailed an invitation link, and
admins choose their own password with it.

invited_at.title: Invited At
invited_at.description: When the latest invitation email went out; null if none ever did.

has_password.title: Has Password
has_password.description: Admins can't log in until they set one with their invitation link.

sanity_author_id.title: Sanity Author Id
sanity_author_id.description: The Sanity author their blog posts are credited to, once linked.

UserRead.title: UserRead
UserRead.description: The whole account: for the user themselves and for admins. Never the password hash.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
Admins: send only the fields that change. `promotion_id`, `birthday` and `bio` can be
set to null to clear them; the other fields can't be null.

WishCreate.title: WishCreate
WishCreate.description: The year isn't sent: the server picks the recipient's next birthday.

WishRead.title: WishRead
WishRead.description: Sender and recipient as every member sees them: no birth year.
